headline: Australia sets a national foundation for AI assurance across government
summary: Australia’s national framework for assurance of AI use in government was agreed and released by the Data and Digital Ministers Meeting on 21 June 2024. It sets a shared foundation for Australian, state and territory governments across development, procurement and deployment, while leaving detailed policy to each jurisdiction. A 22 October 2026 ministerial statement reiterates support for safe and responsible government AI and describes the framework as a key step; it does not announce a new framework or establish binding adoption or measured outcomes.
